display.title: Episode 176: Reb Boruch and the Birth of the Shpoler Zeide (Shabbos Mevarchim Sivan)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi explains why the Torah says 'Yom HaShishi' before Shabbos Mevarchim Sivan, then tells how a hidden tzaddik's blessing brought the Shpoler Zeide into the world.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Shabbos Mevarchim Sivan 5745, during Sefiras HaOmer. Uncle Yossi opens with a teaching from the very first parsha: of all the days of creation, only the sixth has the letter Hei, 'Yom HaShishi'. Rashi explains that the world was created for the sake of the five books of the Torah, given on the sixth of Sivan, so children should be in shul to bless the new month. After a sponsor message, a yeshiva student recites the Shema in Studio 604. Story time tells of Reb Boruch, a generous man who kept a guest house and even swapped tired horses for strong ones. A plain-looking guest turns out to be a hidden tzaddik; through a keyhole Reb Boruch sees him with the soul of the Maharal of Prague, and is promised a son who will carry that soul. At the bris the guest blesses the baby to be a 'Zeide' to all Israel. The guest was the Baal Shem Tov, and the child became the Shpoler Zeide. The show ends with a call for Ahavas Yisroel and achdus before Shavuos by joining the campaign to buy a letter in a new Sefer Torah.
display.lesson: Practice Ahavas Yisroel through tzedakah and hachnasas orchim, and Hashem rewards kindness in wonderful ways.
